title: KPI debt & experiment priority lattice
body:
Purpose and quick summary:
This working sheet captures an operational view of KPI debt (deferred or unmeasured outcomes), pairs that debt with candidate experiments/remediations, and places items in a two-axis priority lattice that balances: impact on key launch KPIs (activation, retention, cost-per-inference) versus execution friction (infra work, cross-team dependencies, vendor/legal review).

Why KPI debt?
- We accumulate KPI debt when a measurement, guardrail, or mitigation is postponed (e.g., not validating model quality on a critical cohort, or disabling prefix cache metrics). Over time this increases launch risk and slows safe experimentation.
- This sheet is designed to help product-ops prioritize which experiments or fixes to make sprint-level commitments against before a milestone (internal beta, external pilot, GA).

How to use this lattice (operational rules):
1) Triage weekly during product-ops sync. Add new items as they surface from oncall, CS, or roadmap spikes.
2) For each item, estimate: baseline KPI (if known), expected delta if resolved, confidence, and execution friction score (1 low — 5 high).
3) Place item into lattice quadrant: 
   - Q1 (High impact, Low friction) = immediate sprint candidate
   - Q2 (High impact, High friction) = scope into cross-functional program or dedicated spike
   - Q3 (Low impact, Low friction) = backlog-tidbits, link to small experiments
   - Q4 (Low impact, High friction) = deprioritize or timebox as research
4) Each sprint pick 2 Q1 items + 1 Q2 runway task (if capacity). Mark owners and acceptance criteria.

Tracker snapshot (columns):
Initiative | Owner | KPI impacted | Baseline | Target delta | Confidence (H/M/L) | Friction (1-5) | Lattice quadrant | Readiness % | Dependency tags | Next action

Sample rows (realistic, but pseudonymized):
- "prefix-cache-metrics" | Ravi Patel | p95 latency (search) | 520ms | -20% | M | 2 | Q1 | 35% | infra,telemetry | add ETL job + dashboard card (owner: Ravi)
- "eval-cohort-failure-detection" | Maya Thompson | QA false-negative rate | 7% | -3pt | H | 3 | Q2 | 15% | research,applied-ml | schedule 3-day spike with ML
- "embedding-retry-policy" | Jinsoo Park | failed embeddings per 1k | 4.2 | -2.0 | H | 1 | Q1 | 60% | sdk,backend | implement exponential backoff + tests
- "billing-visibility-shortfall" | Ava Chen | cost-per-1000 tokens | $8.90 | -$1.50 | M | 4 | Q2 | 10% | finance,legal | draft data access proposal for finance

Readiness checklist (pass/fail heuristics to mark an initiative >70% ready):
- Quantified KPI baseline and target (must be numeric or anchored to a user story)
- Owner assigned and sprint allocation confirmed
- All blocking dependencies annotated with owners and ETA
- Minimal acceptance criteria or measurement plan exists (dashboard or test)
- No outstanding compliance/legal blockers for launch quadrant
- End-to-end smoke test defined (manual or CI)

Sprint playbook for KPI-debt burn-down:
- Monday: product-ops triage sync — move items into lattice, confirm owners
- Tuesday: owners add acceptance criteria + test plans to linked artifacts (Jira or Confluence)
- Wednesday: infra/ML quick sync for Q2 candidates to scope spikes
- Friday: demo mini-checkpoint; update readiness % and move completed items to 'closed' sheet

Decision rules for escalations (if launching within 30 days):
- Any item in Q2 with >25% projected impact to p95 latency or >5% activation drop requires exec notice and dedicated staging window.
- Any Q1 item with readiness <40% must be staffed to hit sprint commitments or a temporary mitigation flagged in the rollback plan.

Ownership notes and conventions:
- Owner is accountable for moving item Readiness to >=70% by the sprint end or producing a mitigation/rollback artifact.
- Confidence reflects expected experiment outcomes, not execution certainty. Low confidence items should include a short 'validation plan' column in Jira.

Open questions and discussion points (triage backlog):
- Should we weight customer-reported incidents higher than internally-detected KPI drift when computing lattice placement? (proposal: yes for pilot cohorts)
- How to encode model-variant fallbacks as part of friction scoring (an extra +1 if multi-variant testing required)?
- Can we wire a lightweight automation to push readiness % based on linked Jira subtask counts?

Notes: This is a working document. Keep commentary inline and keep the canonical mapping in Jira items (use tags: kpi-debt, launch-readiness).

Last triage summary (2026-02-20):
- 6 items in Q1 (2 in progress), 4 items in Q2 (one blocked on legal), average readiness across high-impact initiatives: 42%.
- Action items: Ravi to finish ETL card by 2026-02-28; Jinsoo to merge retry policy PR and add observability by 2026-02-23.
